void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, app background

carbon.$description: Carbon — Elevated surface — cards, modals, popovers

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

steel.$description: Steel — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

fog.$description: Fog — Secondary body text, inactive icon strokes

silver-mist.$description: Silver Mist — Tertiary body text, meta information, timestamps

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, placeholder copy

pewter.$description: Pewter — Primary body text, navigation links, dominant interface text

ice.$description: Ice — Headings, emphasis text, strong links

glacier.$description: Glacier — Bright accent text, active link states, highlight labels

bone.$description: Bone — Navigation hover states, light iconography

chalk.$description: Chalk — Button labels, inverted text on dark fills

absolute-white.$description: Absolute White — Maximum contrast text, inverse fills, poster borders

true-black.$description: True Black — Shadow base, icon glyphs, deepest contrast

acid-green.$description: Acid Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

pro-green.$description: Pro Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

object-fit-cover.$description: object-fit: cover; — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

graphik.$description: Primary UI sans-serif — navigation, buttons, labels, metadata, tags, form controls, and all small-size interface text. The wide letter-spacing at 0.075–0.083em is reserved for uppercase eyebrows and nav labels, giving the chrome a deliberate, almost printed feel. Weight 400 carries body and metadata, 700 for emphasis and buttons.

tiempos-text.$description: Editorial serif for body copy in reviews, log entries, and long-form text. The 15px/1.67 pairing creates generous line height for comfortable reading. Switches the interface from product UI into magazine mode wherever prose appears.

tiempos-headline.$description: Display serif for hero headlines and major page titles. A single use at 36px — the only size where this voice speaks, making it feel ceremonial and rare.

masonry.$description: masonry — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
